reapack.name: munderdifflin_Reception.lua
reapack.desc: Munder Difflin office tools (Reception, Shredder, Stapler, Copier, Binder)

metadata.description:
# Munder Difflin Small, office-themed tools for sound design in REAPER.
- Reception: the front desk. Dial 1-4 to open a tool, 5-9 for custom dials, 0 for the operator. - Shredder: grinds selected audio into randomized, automated fragments. - Stapler: lines up the first transient of every layer, with an offset. - Copier: turns audio into MIDI (ALL, CHORDS, MELODY, BASS, HITS). - Binder: files track templates, FX chains and audio; drag them onto tracks. - Munder Difflin: the business card. Credits, orientation and shared settings.
Tip: bind Reception to a key. When REAPER asks about the already running instance, choose "Terminate instances" + "Remember" and the same key opens/closes it.
